channel.title: Pajhwok Afghan News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Pajhwok Afghan News (pajhwok.com)

item.title: Afghanistan, South Africa to meet in ICC T20 WC encounter today
item.description: Afghanistan are all set to meet South Africa in their second group-stage match in the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup today (Wednesday) at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad.

item.title: 1 killed, 7 injured in Ghazni traffic accident
item.description: One person has been killed and seven others have been injured in a traffic accident in southern Ghazni province, police said on Wednesday.

item.title: Canada school shooting leaves 10 dead
item.description: At least 10 people, including the suspected gunwoman, have been killed and several others wounded in a school shooting in Canada’s British Columbia province, media reported on Wednesday.

item.title: 1 killed, another wounded in Nangarhar mine collapse
item.description: A man has been killed and another injured in a mine collapse in the eastern Nangarhar province, police said on Wednesday.

item.title: DABS, Azizi Group ink agreement for launch of 5 power generation projects
item.description: Da Afghanistan Breshna Sherkat (DABS) and Azizi Energy Investment Company on Wednesday signed a contract for the launch of five power generation projects--- producing 330 megawatts of solar energy and 515 megawatts of coal-fired thermal power.

item.title: Returning athlete unveils slacklining as new sport in Herat
item.description: A slackline athlete has introduced the emerging sport to western Herat province after nearly a decade of professional experience abroad, calling for the establishment of an official national federation to support its development in Afghanistan.

item.title: Afghanistan fall to South Africa in dramatic double super over
item.description: KABUL (Pajhwok): Afghanistan suffered a heartbreaking defeat against South Africa after a dramatic double Super Over in their ICC Men’s T20 World Cup Group D

item.title: KSRelief donates 100 tonnes of dates to Afghanistan
item.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre (KSRelief) has donated 100 tonnes of dates to the Afghan Red Crescent Society (ARCS) ahead of Ramadan to support vulnerable families across Afghanistan.

item.title: US offers payments to Afghans stranded in Qatar to repatriate
item.description: The United States has begun offering financial assistance to Afghan nationals willing to return home, as part of efforts to close a camp in Qatar where many have been stranded for years.

item.title: Experts urge better management of Ghazni solar-powered groundwater
item.description: Some residents and environmental experts in southern Ghazni province have raised concerns over the excessive extraction of groundwater for agricultural purposes using solar power, warning that the practice poses a serious threat to underground water reserves.
